title: Acme Corp
description: Acme Corp processes millions of events per day and needed a scalable solution for real-time analytics and monitoring.
body: Acme Corp processes millions of events per day and needed a scalable solution for real-time analytics and monitoring. The existing solution could not handle the growing data volume and lacked real-time capabilities. By deploying Elastic, Acme Corp achieved sub-second query times across petabytes of data. The engineering team integrated Elasticsearch into their data pipeline within weeks. Elastic transformed how we approach observability and analytics.
summary: Acme Corp processes millions of events per day and needed a scalable solution for real-time analytics and monitoring.
